title: Motorists can now use one RFID for all Luzon expressways
description: . President Marcos led the launch of the “One RFID, All Tollways” system allowing motorists to use a single RFID tag across Luzon’s expressways.

title: ICI urged to probe NAIA concession deal for possible graft, irregularities
description: . The Independent Commission for Infrastructure must widen its probe to include the controversial trillion-worth public-private deal with the New NAIA Infrastructure Corp., critics of the airport’s privatization said Tuesday.

title: Trillanes files plunder raps vs Duterte, Bong Go over P7-B Davao projects
description: . Among the complaints filed against Duterte and Go are violations of the Plunder Law, the Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act and the Code of Conduct for Public Officials.

title: Ralph Recto stays as DOF chief, says Palace
description: . The Palace on Tuesday, October 21, dispelled rumors that Department of Finance Secretary Ralph Recto is handing in his resignation letter.

title: P243-B in 'unprogrammed funds': Why House says they're not taxpayer money
description: . It looks like a massive P243-billion pot on paper, but the House appropriations chair said such "unprogrammed funds" cannot be used for infrastructure.

title: 'Bothered by conscience': Lawmakers in corruption scandal turning to church
description: . Kalookan Bishop Cardinal Pablo Virgilio David revealed that some lawmakers involved in corruption have sought counsel from the clergy, saying they were “bothered by their conscience.”

title: ‘Corruption, weak disaster preparedness could stall Philippines growth’
description: . The Philippine Institute for Development Studies has warned that the country’s economic growth could be derailed by the combined effects of climate change, weak disaster preparedness and persistent corruption.

title: Diesel price rollback, gas hike today
description: . Diesel and kerosene prices are set to decline today, bringing much-needed relief to motorists.

title: Tulfo raises human trafficking issue at Geneva IPU Assembly
description: . Senators Raffy Tulfo and Imee Marcos were among the representatives of the Philippines at the 151st Inter-Parliamentary Union Assembly last Sunday at the Geneva International Conference Center.

title: President Marcos attending Asean Summit in Malaysia
description: . President Marcos will be at the 47th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits in Malaysia from Oct. 26 to 28 and will witness the turnover of the chairmanship of the regional bloc to the Philippines and the signing of several key agreements.

title: Kim Atienza’s daughter Emman, 19, passes away
description: . The daughter of TV host and personality Kim Atienza, Emmanuelle “Emman,” has passed away at the age of 19.

title: Secret reversal of Villanueva’s dismissal? Palace wants probe
description: . Malacañang has called for an investigation into reports that former ombudsman Samuel Martires issued a “secret decision” reversing a 2016 dismissal order of the agency against Sen. Joel Villanueva, who had been accused of misusing pork barrel funds.

title: ICC affirms jurisdiction over Duterte case
description: . The International Criminal Court has cleared a key hurdle in the ongoing proceedings against detained former president Rodrigo Duterte, with the Pre-Trial Chamber I saying the ICC retains jurisdiction over the crimes against humanity case.

title: Kiko declares P26.7 million net worth; Gatchalian, P89.5 million
description: . Senators Francis Pangilinan and Sherwin Gatchalian yesterday made public their statement of assets, liabilities and net worth.

title: Government workers, retirees stand by GSIS leadership
description: . Three organizations representing government employees and retirees have expressed full support for the leadership of the Government Service Insurance System under president and general manager Jose Arnulfo “Wick” Veloso, citing transparency, sound financial management and continued engagement with members.

title: Napoles, NLDC head get 68 years over PDAF
description: . The Sandiganbayan has sentenced businesswoman Janet Lim-Napoles, together with Gondelina Amata, the former president of the defunct state-owned firm National Livelihood Development Corp. (NLDC), and Michael Lim Benjamin, the former chief political officer of former senator Gregorio Honasan II, to up to 68 years in prison in connection with the alleged misuse of the latter’s Priority Development Assistance Fund (PDAF).

title: Zero tolerance for Church sex abuse – Pope Leo
description: . Pope Leo XIV reiterated his stance of zero tolerance for any form of abuse within the Church as Catholic leaders in the Philippines gathered to address clerical sexual abuse.

title: DepEd taps ADB, World Bank to build 55,000 classrooms
description: . The Department of Education will seek the assistance of the Asian Development Bank (ADB) and the World Bank (WB) in constructing at least 55,000 classrooms to help address the classroom backlog of 165,000, a DepEd official said yesterday.

title: Fuel price hike next week
description: . Motorists should brace for an increase in fuel prices next week, triggered by ongoing geopolitical tensions.

title: Senate questions P8 billion farm-to-market roads in DPWH budget
description: . Proposed funding for farm-to-market roads nearly doubled in the 2026 budget process, increasing from P16 billion in the National Expenditure Program to P32.6 billion in the version of the General Appropriations Bill passed by the House of Representatives.

title: Marcos freezes basic goods prices until yearend
description: . President Marcos has directed the Department of Trade and Industry to enforce a price freeze on basic and prime commodities until the end of the year to ensure price stability during the holiday season.

title: Marcos, new Japan Prime Minister agree to pursue ACSA
description: . The Philippines and Japan have agreed in principle on an Acquisition and Cross-Servicing Agreement that will allow the Japan Self-Defense Forces and the Philippine military to exchange supplies and services.

title: GCash says accounts safe amid alleged data breach
description: . GCash yesterday assured users of the e-wallet that their accounts and funds are secure in the app following an advisory from the National Privacy Commission to exercise heightened vigilance after an alleged data leak.

title: Quo warranto petition filed against Erwin Tulfo
description: . Sen. Erwin Tulfo is facing legal action challenging his right to be in office due to citizenship, the Senate Electoral Tribunal bared yesterday.

title: Fuel prices surge by up to P2/L
description: . Pump prices of petroleum products are set to climb by as much as P2 per liter today as tensions abroad continue to rattle the global oil market.

title: PAGASA: Northeast monsoon starts
description: . The northeast monsoon has started blowing over the Philippine domain, declared the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration.

title: Marcos hits China’s ‘nature reserve’ declaration
description: . President Marcos has slammed the “attempt of some actors” to establish a “nature reserve” in Bajo de Masinloc or Panatag (Scarborough) Shoal, which is an integral part of the Philippines.

title: Flood control? DENR flags Laguna de Bay reclamation
description: . Flood control project or reclamation activity?

title: Manila cemeteries launch grave finder
description: . Two public cemeteries in Manila have launched online platforms that allow users to locate graves and tombs of their departed loved ones.

title: Rainy Undas seen; Pagasa monitors LPA
description: . Rain and thunderstorms are expected to affect several parts of the country during the Undas weekend, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA) said yesterday.

title: Address proliferation of teacher education diploma mills, CHED told
description: . The Second Congressional Commission on Education (EDCOM 2) yesterday asked the Commission on Higher Education (CHED) to address the proliferation of diploma mills offering teacher education masters and PhDs.

title: ICC appoints presiding judge in Duterte jurisdiction appeal
description: . The Appeals Chamber of the International Criminal Court has appointed the presiding judge who will handle the appeal filed by the defense team of former president Rodrigo Duterte on the ICC’s jurisdiction over alleged crimes against humanity in the Philippines.

title: Philippines, US create joint task force vs South China Sea threats
description: . The Philippines and the United States jointly announced yesterday the creation of “Task Force Philippines” which seeks to counter China’s coercive and aggressive behavior in the South China Sea and West Philippine Sea.

title: Philippine restaurants get Michelin stars, honors
description: . A total of 108 restaurants and eateries in the Philippines, which serve a wide range of society from the rich to the masses, were given various levels of honors by the prestigious travelogue Michelin Guide.

title: Grab launches P2P carpool program
description: . Ride-hailing company Grab Philippines is testing another transport solution in Metro Manila, this time emulating the point-to-point (P2P) system of premium buses and shuttle vans.

title: Palace: government has ‘very high’ level of readiness for Undas
description: . Malacañang assured the public yesterday that the government is ready for the observance of All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day, including the exodus of passengers to provinces.

title: Public access to SALNs takes effect November 15
description: . Starting Nov. 15, the public, including members of media, may request copies of the statements of assets, liabilities and net worth (SALNs) of government officials under the custody of the Office of the Ombudsman.

title: 50 percent of families consider themselves poor – SWS
description: . Fifty percent of Filipino families considers themselves poor, according to a recent survey by Social Weather Stations Inc.

title: Palace workers share ghost encounters
description: . In this season of “ghost” projects, employees at Malacañang Palace shared their creepy encounters with ghosts – the supernatural kind – while working at the official residence of the president of the republic.

title: INC to hold three-day rally in Rizal Park
description: . The Iglesia ni Cristo will hold a three-day rally in Rizal Park in Manila, from Nov. 16 to 18, reportedly to call for transparency and accountability in government.

title: 30 DPWH cases now under investigation
description: . Around 30 cases involving the Department of Public Works and Highways are now under preliminary investigation as the government prepares to file charges in relation to anomalies in flood control projects.

title: Tighter budget rules eyed to deter corruption, patronage
description: . The Senate will pursue a more systematic and evidence-based approach to the budgeting process to curb the yearly average of P385 billion in unused appropriations, which Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo Lacson said stems from a culture of patronage in fund allocations.

title: ‘In conflict, Philippines must fight first before seeking help’
description: . In case of war, the Philippines will have to fight and defend itself first before turning to the United States and other allies for help, Armed Forces of the Philippines chief Gen. Romeo Brawner Jr. said yesterday.

title: Government year-end bonus, P5,000 gift released this month
description: . Government employees across the country can expect to receive their much-anticipated year-end bonus and P5,000 cash gift within the first week of November, according to the Department of Budget and Management.

title: DA: Rice supply enough despite import ban
description: . The Department of Agriculture expects the country’s rice inventory to reach up to 3.4 million metric tons by the end of the year – enough to last for 89 days amid President Marcos’ order to extend the rice importation ban until Dec. 31.

title: Lacson dares Guteza: Present physical evidence
description: . Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo Lacson dared missing witness Orly Guteza to surface and present physical evidence to back up his allegation that he delivered millions of cash stuffed in Rimowa suitcases to the homes of former speaker Martin Romualdez and resigned Ako Bicol Rep. Zaldy Co.

title: DepEd: Reforms underway to address functional illiteracy
description: . Reforms are underway to address functional illiteracy in the Philippines, the Department of Education said yesterday.

title: 2 Philippines businesswomen make Forbes Asia power list
description: . Two Filipinos made it to Forbes Asia’s Power Businesswomen 2025 list that featured 20 female leaders “at the forefront of the region’s fast-evolving business and economic landscape.”

title: Rizal bust in Paris missing
description: . National hero Jose Rizal’s bust in Paris, France is missing, the Department of Foreign Affairs reported yesterday.

title: Can ex-DPWH chief Bonoan leave without permission? DOJ explains
description: . The Department of Justice said that former Department of Public Works and Highways secretary Manuel Bonoan can leave the country.

title: DPWH to sue Hi-Tone Construction over unrepaired Navotas seawall
description: . Hi-Tone Construction Corp. may face a case from the Department of Public Works and Highways for failing to repair a collapsed seawall in Navotas City and causing severe flooding.

title: Gatchalian sponsors 2026 budget
description: . Senate finance committee chair Sherwin Gatchalian yesterday sponsored the proposed P6.793 trillion national budget in 2026, paving the way for plenary debates on the national outlay.

title: ‘Marcoleta, Magalong not part of government destabilization plot’
description: . Insinuations that Sen. Rodante Marcoleta is part of a supposed destabilization plot against the Marcos administration are fake news, Interior and Local Government Secretary Jonvic Remulla said yesterday.

title: Sara expects ombudsman to release her SALN
description: . Vice President Sara Duterte supports the release of her statements of assets, liabilities and net worth (SALN), expressing confidence that the ombudsman will make them public once requested.

title: Comelec proclaims Zaldy Co replacement in Congress
description: . The Commission on Elections yesterday proclaimed Jan Franz Almario Chan, Ako Bicol party-list third nominee, replacing resigned congressman Zaldy Co.

title: DepEd releases P661.1 million for school repairs after Uwan
description: . The Department of Education has released P661.1 million to fund the repair of nearly 3,000 schools damaged by Super Typhoon Uwan.

title: DENR slammed for ‘reactive’ response to environmental
description: . Sen. Raffy Tulfo called for stronger environmental protection and accountability, particularly in the management of the country’s protected areas, following the recent landfall of Super Typhoon Uwan which battered Luzon over the weekend.

title: Imee: Flood control witnesses to recant due to threats
description: . Witnesses in previous Senate Blue Ribbon committee hearings on flood control corruption will recant their testimonies following threats to their safety, Sen. Imee Marcos claimed yesterday.

title: ‘ICC arrest warrant for Bato came from third source’
description: . The copy of a warrant of arrest allegedly from the International Criminal Court against Sen. Ronald dela Rosa obtained by Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla came from a third source, his brother Interior and Local Government Secretary Jonvic Remulla said yesterday.

title: 3 ex-undersecretaries under probe for money laundering
description: . Ombudsman Boying Remulla is investigating three ex-undersecretaries for alleged money laundering tied to DPWH fund transfers.

title: The Marcos feud: Analysts see legacy, power struggles driving family tensions
description: . Why did Sen. Imee Marcos accuse her own brother, President Marcos Jr., of using illegal drugs — and what does it mean for the corruption scandal unfolding today?

title: Senators eulogize Enrile
description: . The Senate yesterday held a necrological service for Juan Ponce Enrile, the chamber’s former leader whose role from martial law to people power made him a polarizing figure in Philippine politics.

title: Ombudsman seeks Interpol red notice for Zaldy Co
description: . The Sandiganbayan has raffled the cases filed by the Office of the Ombudsman against resigned lawmaker Zaldy Co and several officials of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Region 4-B among the anti-graft court’s fifth, sixth and seventh divisions.

title: Senate approves DA’s P184 billion budget for 2026
description: . The Senate has approved the Department of Agriculture’s proposed P184.1-billion budget for 2026, a move the DA said would strengthen initiatives to improve food security and support rural development.

title: Comelec to rule next week on Chiz campaign donors
description: . The Commission on Elections is expected to come out next week with its ruling on the legality of Sen. Francis Escudero’s acceptance of donations from a government contractor for his 2022 campaign.

title: Former ES Bersamin: I did not resign
description: . Contrary to what Malacañang had announced, former executive secretary Lucas Bersamin yesterday said he did not resign but had willingly stepped down when told he was being replaced.

title: Flood control scandal: ICI wants 17 on lookout bulletin
description: . The Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) has requested the Department of Justice to issue immigration lookout bulletin orders against 17 people facing charges of graft and malversation of public funds before the Sandiganbayan in connection with an anomalous flood control project worth P289.5 million in Naujan, Oriental Mindoro.

title: Marcos  to students: Engage in sports
description: . President Marcos poked fun at his health yesterday as he tried to lift a 120-kilo barbell when he visited the newly renovated facilities at the PhilSports Complex in Pasig City.

title: Ex-usec Bernardo sought out Lacson to tell all
description: . Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo Lacson yesterday detailed how former Department of Public Works and Highways undersecretary Roberto Bernardo reached out to him with the intention to tell all in his bid to become a state witness in the flood control corruption scandal.

title: AMLC: Frozen assets in flood scam reach P13 billion
description: . The total value of frozen assets of construction companies has reached P13 billion and is projected to rise further as the investigation deepens, the Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) has said.

title: Baguio chill begins at 13.8 degrees Celsius
description: . Baguio City’s trademark December cold has officially arrived, with the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA) recording a temperature of 13.8 degrees Celsius yesterday.

title: Weak La Niña seen to bring above-normal rainfall
description: . Most parts of the country may experience above-normal rainfall through February 2026 as a weak and short-lived La Niña continues to develop in the tropical Pacific, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA) reported yesterday.

title: P18.6 billion calamity fund used in 11 months
description: . The national government has utilized P18.6 billion from the national calamity fund to support disaster relief and rehabilitation efforts across the country from January to November, data from the Department of Budget and Management (DBM) showed.

title: DOJ usec Cadiz resigns amid flood mess allegations
description: . Justice undersecretary Jojo Cadiz, who has been linked to the flood control anomalies, has resigned, Presidential Communications Undersecretary Claire Castro said.

title: President Marcos orders DILG, PNP to track down Sarah Discaya, others
description: . President Marcos yesterday directed the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) and the Philippine National Police (PNP) to track the whereabouts of controversial contractor Sarah Discaya and several other respondents to ensure their immediate arrest upon issuance of the warrants in connection with a P100-million ghost flood control project in Davao Occidental.

title: Gatchalian vows transparency in amendments to 2026 budget
description: . Senate finance committee chair Sherwin Gatchalian assured senators that they would all be informed of the line-by-line amendments in the proposed 2026 national budget, which the upper chamber passed on second reading on Thursday.

title: SC: votes for nuisance candidates considered strays
description: . Votes cast for a nuisance candidate shall be considered “stray votes” and shall not be counted in favor of any other candidate, according to a new rule set by the Supreme Court (SC).

title: Palace: MUP pay hike not linked to destabilization plot
description: . Malacañang defended on Friday the base pay adjustment for military and uniformed personnel (MUP) and President Marcos’ visits and meetings with the military, saying these were meant to check the troops’ welfare and not related to supposed destabilization plots.

title: Expect over P1/L gas price hike next week
description: . Motorists should brace for fuel price increases next week, with gasoline expected to jump by more than P1 per liter.

title: ‘ICI investigative work nearing completion’
description: . The Independent Commission for Infrastructure is about to be done with its investigative work, according to special adviser Rodolfo Azurin Jr.

title: Marcos impeach case transmitted to Speaker’s office
description: . A verified impeachment complaint filed against President Marcos is now in the office of Speaker Faustino Dy III after being transmitted by House of Representatives secretary-general Cheloy Garafil.

title: Atong Ang surrenders firearms
description: . The camp of fugitive gambling tycoon Charlie “Atong” Ang has surrendered five of his six firearms after the Philippine National Police revoked their licenses.

title: Marcos Jr., BSP discuss monetary policy, growth outlook
description: . The monetary policy easing cycle may be nearing its end, the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) said, as it briefed President Marcos on the country’s economic outlook.

title: Dizon: DPWH campus job fair successful
description: . Public Works Secretary Vince Dizon yesterday welcomed the strong response to the agency’s first campus job fair at the Mapúa University, saying it exceeded expectations despite concerns over the flood corruption mess.

title: CICC to lift ban  on Grok AI
description: . The government is set to end its ban on Grok, less than a week after it prohibited the artificial intelligence chatbot for its sexually explicit content, the Cybercrime Investigation and Coordinating Center said yesterday.

title: Ping: Minority report on flood control ‘disrespects’ Blue Ribbon
description: . Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo Lacson described as invalid and disrespectful the so-called minority report on the flood control controversy, stressing that only the Blue Ribbon committee can issue an official committee report under Senate rules.

title: After Bong Revilla, Villanueva next?
description: . Following the arrest and detention of former senator Ramon “Bong” Revilla Jr. in connection with the flood control scandal, could Sen. Joel Villanueva be next?

title: Sara faces 2nd plunder complaint
description: . A second plunder complaint has been filed against Vice President Sara Duterte over her alleged misuse of over P600 million in confidential funds of the Office of the Vice President and the Department of Education and for supposed anomalies during her term as Davao City mayor, including her alleged receipt of money from drug dealers.

title: ‘Up to 11 cyclones may enter Philippines from February to July’
description: . Four to 11 tropical cyclones are likely to develop or enter the Philippine area of responsibility (PAR) between February and July this year, according to the climate outlook presented during the 192nd Climate Forum held yesterday.

title: DOH allays public fears on Nipah virus
description: . The Department of Health is prepared for the possible entry of the Nipah virus following reported outbreaks in India and Bangladesh.

title: Sara slams ‘biased’ ICC
description: . After failing to get a ruling in favor of her father, detained former president Rodrigo Duterte, Vice President Sara Duterte accused the International Criminal Court of being “biased.”

title: Divers search for missing passengers in Basilan
description: . Nineteen technical wreck divers and a Remote Operated Vehicle (ROV) from the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) commenced diving and search operations for the 10 missing passengers of M/V Trisha Kerstin 3 off Baluk-Baluk Island in Hadji Muhtamad town.

title: ‘Eradicating corruption will take several lifetimes’
description: . In her first public remarks since resigning from the Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI), Sycip Gorres Velayo (SGV) & Co. country managing partner Rossana Fajardo admitted that “it’s very hard to undo” corruption in government.

title: Senate mulls suspending Bato’s salary
description: . The Senate ethics committee will look into the proposal to suspend the salary of Sen. Ronald dela Rosa, who has been hiding amid a supposed arrest warrant issued by the International Criminal Court.

title: Philippines seeks cooperation to boost tourism in ASEAN
description: . With tourism still perceived by many as a numbers game, the Department of Tourism appealed to its counterparts in Southeast Asia to “move forward not as competing destinations but as a unified region.”

title: ‘Marcos presence in impeach proceedings up to legal team’
description: . Malacañang is leaving it up to President Marcos’ legal team to decide whether he would show up at the hearings of the House of Representatives’ justice committee on the impeachment complaint against him.

title: I’m OK, Marcos Jr. says on health
description: . Amid rumors of his alleged deteriorating health, President Marcos appeared in a video message last night, assuring the public that he is fine while he continues to take medications for his diverticulitis.

title: China poses ‘greatest threat’ to Philippines – poll
description: . A majority of Filipinos continue to distrust China, with almost eight in 10 seeing the Asian giant as the “greatest threat” to the Philippines, a survey conducted by the OCTA Research group showed.

title: 1,500 socmed accounts covertly involved in 2022 polls – UP study
description: . A study conducted by experts from the University of the Philippines and other foreign universities found that at least 1,500 social media influencer accounts were involved in covert or under-the-radar campaigning during the 2022 general elections.

title: DOJ: Only authorized agencies can conduct cybercrime raids
description: . Only authorized law enforcement agencies can conduct cybercrime raids, serve warrants and seize electronic devices, the Department of Justice’s Office of Cybercrime said.

title: Gatchalian seeks Senate probe into Cebu landfill collapse
description: . Sen. Sherwin Gatchalian has filed a resolution seeking a Senate inquiry into the landfill collapse in Binaliw, Cebu, which left more than 30 people dead and several others injured.

title: Government urged to strengthen anti-trafficking laws
description: . With human trafficking continuing to be a persistent concern in the country, the Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines (CBCP) yesterday made an urgent appeal to the government to strengthen the laws and enforcement against human trafficking.

title: Senate panel seeks to shield aid distribution from politics
description: . The Senate committee on social justice, welfare, and rural development is pushing to simplify access to government aid and shield its distribution from political influence, as it deliberates a measure seeking to institutionalize the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD)’s Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situations (AICS) program.

title: BOC to hold third auction of Discaya cars
description: . The Bureau of Customs (BOC) will auction off eight of the luxury cars previously owned by contractor couple Curlee and Sarah Discaya, and two other luxury vehicles, this month at the Port of Manila.

title: Rains seen over south Luzon, Visayas
description: . Moderate to heavy rains can be expected over southern Luzon and Visayas this week, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA) said yesterday.

title: President Marcos to public: Suggest solutions to pressing issues
description: . Citing the need to review outdated government policies, President Marcos yesterday encouraged the public to share their suggestions in addressing pressing issues.

title: Makabayan bloc to refile impeach case vs VP Sara
description: . With the lapse of the Supreme Court’s one-year bar rule on filing an impeachment complaint against Vice President Sara Duterte on Feb. 6, the Makabayan bloc of the House of Representatives is gearing up to file another case against her.

title: Senate to discuss resolution vs Chinese diplomat
description: . Despite opposition from several senators now being tagged as “pro-China,” the Senate will try to adopt today a proposed resolution condemning Chinese embassy officials who criticized Philippine officials for speaking out in defense of national sovereignty and maritime rights.

title: Philippine embassy in Seoul joins International Customs Day
description: . South Korea’s Customs Service has highlighted its use of artificial intelligence and digital technologies to improve efficiency, inspections and risk response.

title: DA eyes ‘supply fixes’ amid food inflation pressure
description: . The Department of Agriculture (DA) yesterday said that it is eyeing “supply fixes” as food inflation looms.

title: Navy to build detachment in Tubbataha Reef
description: . The Philippine Navy is set to establish a station in the Sulu Sea aimed mainly at helping protect the marine environment in Tubbataha Reef in Palawan while also monitoring foreign vessel traffic in the area.

title: Leviste ready for the worst, vows to release videos
description: . Neophyte Rep. Leandro Leviste is fully prepared for the worst that could happen to him with regard to purported key evidence implicating high government officials in the flood control scandal, expressing confidence that the evidence will come out in due time.

title: Sandigan affirms case vs Revilla, rejects jail transfer
description: . he Sandiganbayan anti-graft court has affirmed the sufficiency of the non-bailable case of malversation of public funds through falsification of public documents filed by the Office of the Ombudsman against former senator Ramon “Bong” Revilla Jr. and six former officials of the Department of Public Works and Highways in Bulacan in connection with an alleged P92.8-million ghost flood control project in Pandi town.

title: ‘Sexual AI images using kids’ photos proliferate’
description: . New evidence revealed a proliferation of sexualized images of youngsters generated by artificial intelligence (AI), the United Nations children’s agency warned.

title: ‘Poor infrastructure led to pricey Batanes, Siargao airfares’
description: . Airfares to two major tourist spots in the country – Batanes and Siargao – are expensive largely due to lack of infrastructure in those destinations, according to a tourism executive.

title: DILG chief cites breakthroughs in law enforcement, public trust
description: . Law enforcement in the country has vastly improved on the heels of sweeping police reforms and as shown by declining crime rates and improving public trust, Interior and Local Government Secretary Jonvic Remulla said yesterday.

title: Church, Catholic schools to Congress: Act now vs dynasties, corruption
description: . Congress should act decisively against political dynasties and massive corruption in government, Catholic groups said yesterday as the 40th EDSA anniversary on Feb. 25 approaches.

title: Palace: No talks to replace DOT chief
description: . No discussions have been made about replacing Tourism Secretary Christina Frasco, Malacañang said yesterday, following fresh rumors that she is on her way out of the Cabinet.

title: Marcos Jr. works outside Palace for first time since ailment
description: . Nearly two weeks after being diagnosed with an illness in the large intestine, President Marcos yesterday resumed attending events outside Malacañang, wherein he reaffirmed his support for efforts to develop the country’s workforce and boost digital connectivity.

title: Diesel, gas prices going up anew today
description: . Major oil firms are set to raise fuel prices again today, with diesel and kerosene hitting their seventh straight week of increases.

title: Meralco rates likely up in February
description: . Higher pass-through charges are expected to push up Manila Electric Co. power rates this month.

title: Palace to review ICI accomplishment report
description: . Malacañang is set to review the accomplishment report of the Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI), whose operations have been affected due to a lack of quorum following the resignation of two of its members.

title: Stricter screening of school project contractors urged
description: . As the Senate continued its review of the government’s expanded public-private partnership program, Sen. Raffy Tulfo called on the Department of Education (DepEd) to strengthen its screening and monitoring of contractors involved in the Public-Private Partnership for School Infrastructure Project 1 and 2.

title: House panel adopts ruling scrapping 2 Marcos Jr. impeach raps
description: . The House of Representatives’ committee on justice has voted to adopt its Feb. 4 report declaring the impeachment complaints against President Marcos insufficient in substance.

title: 3 in 4 Pinoy students use AI writing tools – poll
description: . More Filipino students are using artificial intelligence tools for educational purposes, particularly in paraphrasing and writing academic tasks, according to an ASEAN Foundation report.

title: Palace pushes faster corruption probes, asset freeze
description: . Malacañang cited the need to promptly investigate alleged anomalies and freeze assets linked to corruption after the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) admitted that the country faces the risk of returning to the Financial Action Task Force “gray list” due to corruption issues.

title: 3rd impeach complaint filed vs VP Sara
description: . A third impeachment complaint has been filed against Vice President Sara Duterte, this time by religious groups and lawyers demanding accountability mainly for her still unliquidated P612.5-million confidential funds.

title: Marcos off to US in March for UN assembly
description: . President Marcos will travel to the United States next month for a four-day working visit, Malacañang announced yesterday.

title: Senate adopts resolution vs China diplomats
description: . After two weeks of being held back by colleagues, senators pushing for a measure condemning Chinese diplomats for their hostile statements against Filipino officials have finally secured victory.

title: 27 percent of Pinoys experienced or saw cheating in relationships
description: . One in four Filipinos either personally experienced or witnessed some form of cheating in relationships, according to a survey conducted by Social Weather Stations (SWS).

title: 500 more drug war ‘victims’ to join ICC case
description: . Pre-trial judges of the International Criminal Court (ICC) have authorized another 500 victims to participate in the ongoing crimes against humanity proceedings against former president Rodrigo Duterte.

title: Word war rages between Chinese embassy, lawmakers
description: . There appears to be no ceasefire in sight between lawmakers and the Chinese embassy, with both trading barbs before the weekend over the recent Senate resolution condemning Chinese diplomats for making hostile remarks against Philippine officials.

title: Blue Ribbon urged to probe Bersamin link to flood mess
description: . The Senate Blue Ribbon committee should investigate the alleged involvement of former legislative liaison officer Adrian Bersamin in the flood control anomaly, including his alleged text messages with President Marcos, House senior deputy minority leader and Caloocan Rep. Edgar Erice said.

title: DENR sets 5-year effort to protect Philippine Rise
description: . Amid threats to the country’s marine resources, food security and maritime domain, the government has begun a five-year effort to protect the Philippine Rise, the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) said yesterday.

title: Geopolitical tensions drive fuel prices higher
description: . Motorists should brace for yet another domestic pump price hike next week amid heightened tensions abroad.

title: VP Sara slams Palace after being accused of spreading falsehoods
description: . Vice President Sara Duterte yesterday hit back at Malacañang after Presidential Communications Undersecretary Claire Castro said she has a “talent” for spreading falsehoods.

title: Metro Manila subway project moving quickly – President Marcos
description: . The construction of the 33.1-kilometer Metro Manila subway project (MMSP) is moving quickly, President Marcos said yesterday, underscoring the administration’s sustained investments in rail and other transportation infrastructure.

title: Castro hits VP Sara, warns vs 2028 Manchurian puppet
description: . Presidential Communications Undersecretary Claire Castro yesterday hit back at Vice President Sara Duterte, saying it is possible that the Philippines would no longer be a country by 2028 if Filipinos elect a Manchurian candidate.

title: SC to ombudsman, ICI: Comment on Zaldy petition
description: . The Supreme Court (SC) has ordered Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla and the Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) to justify their findings that linked former Ako Bicol party-list congressman and fugitive Elizaldy Co to an anomalous flood control project in Oriental Mindoro.

title: CHED incapacitated by outdated charter, staffing shortages – EDCOM 2
description: . The Commission on Higher Education is severely incapacitated in monitoring the quality of higher education institutions due to its outdated charter and critical staffing shortages, the Second Congressional Commission on Education revealed.

title: South Korea supports Philippines ASEAN hosting
description: . South Korea has expressed support for the Philippines’ hosting of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations Summit this year and its desire to boost ties with the region, a key global economic player and investment destination.

title: De Lima files resolutions probing ‘weaponization’ of anti-terror laws
description: . Mamamayang Liberal party-list Rep. Leila de Lima has filed two resolutions seeking a congressional inquiry into the implementation of the Anti-Terrorism Act of 2020 and the Terrorism Financing Prevention and Suppression Act of 2012 following the denial of bail to community journalist Frenchie Mae Cumpio and lay worker Marielle Domequil.

title: ICC denies appeal bid on Duterte’s fitness
description: . Pre-trial judges of the International Criminal Court have denied former president Rodrigo Duterte’s request to appeal the decision declaring him fit to participate in pre-trial proceedings.

title: DepEd starts public consultations on trimester system
description: . The Department of Education is continuing consultations on the proposed shift to a trimester school calendar, following Malacañang’s directive to ensure extensive dialogues with stakeholders before any implementation.

title: AI cannot duplicate human conscience, Catholic schools say
description: . Members of the Catholic Educational Association of the Philippines said artificial intelligence cannot duplicate the human conscience as they pushed for the responsible integration of AI into the teaching-learning process.

title: New tech eyed for speedy school construction
description: . Modern construction technologies are being explored by the public works and education departments to accelerate classroom building nationwide.

title: Marcoleta agrees to debate Carpio on West Philippine Sea
description: . Sen. Rodante Marcoleta has accepted retired Supreme Court senior associate justice Antonio Carpio’s challenge to debate on the South China Sea issue.

title: DFA hits China embassy over ‘coercive’ warning
description: . The Department of Foreign Affairs has expressed concern over the Chinese embassy’s “coercive” statement attributing job losses among Filipinos to strained bilateral relations.

title: Philippines, US boost alliance for Indo-Pacific deterrence
description: . The Philippines and the United States committed to maintaining a vigilant posture in the region and strengthening the alliance to reestablish deterrence in the Indo-Pacific as they condemned China’s illegal, coercive, aggressive and deceptive activities in the South China Sea.

title: DepEd calls for better employment pathway
description: . The Department of Education (DepEd) yesterday pushed for a better education-to-employment pathway as it emphasized the importance of stronger alignment of educational institutions, training providers, industry partners and government agencies.

title: AFP strengthening cyber defenses
description: . The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) assured the pubic yesterday that it is continuously strengthening the military’s cyber defense capabilities, amid this year’s increasing threat of cyber attacks stemming from geopolitical tensions in the West Philippine Sea.

title: Stricter regulation sought amid rice retail price uptick
description: . Stricter regulation is needed to curb the rising retail prices of rice, an agricultural group said yesterday.

title: Fair, implementable anti-dynasty law vowed
description: . Speaker Faustino Dy III yesterday assured the public that the House of Representatives would pass a fair, just and implementable Anti-Political Dynasty bill, as lawmakers brought the Mindanao leg of nationwide consultations to Cagayan de Oro City.

title: Naga prepares for President Marcos visit
description: . Preparations are underway in Naga City for the expected visit of President Marcos this weekend.

title: Philippine fumbles potential $1 billion US defense loan
description: . The Philippines missed its chance to receive a $1-billion defense loan from the United States through a bipartisan defense bill last year due to bureaucratic hurdles and restrictions imposed by domestic law.

title: Court order required before Jinggoy, Bonoan can travel abroad
description: . Sen. Jinggoy Estrada, former Department of Public Works and Highways secretary Manuel Bonoan, and others under precautionary hold-departure order by a Manila regional trial court, cannot leave the country unless they secure a court order for any travel abroad, the Bureau of Immigration (BI) said.

title: Tarriela: 2028 poll outcome a concern for China
description: . The outcome of the 2028 national elections is a concern for China as it could carve out policy direction on the West Philippine Sea, according to Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) spokesman on WPS issues, Commodore Jay Tarriela.

title: Fuel prices going up for 9th straight week
description: . Diesel and kerosene prices are headed for a ninth consecutive increase next week as rising geopolitical tensions continue to threaten global oil supplies.

title: Tulfo meets Australian envoy; demand for Pinoy workers highlighted
description: . Australian Ambassador Marc Innes-Brown visited the office of Senate committee on migrant workers chairman Raffy Tulfo on Feb. 18.

title: Day 2 at ICC: Prosecution ties data, Duterte's speech, structure to killings
description: . ICC prosecutors argued Duterte's speeches, data and internal orders show a widespread, systematic state attack.

title: Lacson, Marcoleta trade barbs anew over West Philippine Sea
description: . Another word war between Senate President Pro-Tempore Panfilo Lacson and Sen. Rodante Marcoleta over the Kalayaan Island Group erupted yesterday, centering on what Tomas Cloma should be remembered for – as a discoverer of the KIG or just a seafarer.

title: Trillanes denies $2 million bribe from Co for ICC
description: . Former senator Antonio Trillanes IV yesterday vowed to file cyber libel complaints against a lawyer, a former politician and several others for accusing him of receiving $2 million from fugitive lawmaker Zaldy Co supposedly to facilitate the investigation of the International Criminal Court (ICC) on the bloody drug war of former president Rodrigo Duterte.

title: Total lunar eclipse expected on March 3
description: . A total lunar eclipse is expected to be seen in the country’s skies next week, according to the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration.

title: Angara promotes PPPs to address classroom lack
description: . Education Secretary Sonny Angara underscored yesterday the crucial role of public-private partnerships (PPPs) in accelerating classroom construction to address the country’s 165,000-classroom backlog.

title: ‘Duterte drew up death lists, boasted about murders’
description: . Former president Rodrigo Duterte personally drew up “death lists” and boasted about murders committed during his “war on drugs,” an International Criminal Court prosecutor said yesterday.

title: House panel tackles VP impeachment on March 2
description: . The House committee on justice will begin deliberations on the four impeachment complaints against Vice President Sara Duterte on March 2, 3 and 4.

title: ‘People power a democratic necessity,  not just  nostalgia’
description: . As the country marks the 40th anniversary of the EDSA people power revolt today, the University of the Philippines-Diliman University Council reminded the public that the event is more than “nostalgia” – it is a democratic necessity.

title: EJK victims left teary-eyed in ICC courtroom
description: . For victims of former president Rodrigo Duterte’s war on drugs, Monday’s confirmation of charges hearing at the International Criminal Court (ICC) was a giant leap toward justice – with those physically present in The Hague described as “teary-eyed” during the proceedings.

title: Duterte also wants to skip detention hearing
description: . Former president Rodrigo Duterte has requested the International Criminal Court (ICC) to allow him to waive his attendance at the scheduled hearing regarding his detention on Friday.

title: Palace on flood probe results: Be patient
description: . Malacañang has appealed to the public to await the results of the investigations on the multibillion-peso flood control controversy with patience, saying investigators are being thorough in their job.

title: Duterte has accepted his fate – Kaufman
description: . As he and his accusers await the International Criminal Court’s decision in 60 days whether to confirm the charges against him, former president Rodrigo Duterte appears resigned to the prospect of dying in prison for crimes against humanity, according to his chief lawyer.

title: Duterte will likely go on trial – Expert
description: . Based on what transpired during the hearings on the confirmation of charges against him, former president Rodrigo Duterte is likely to go on trial for crimes against humanity, according to a constitutional expert.

title: Charges eyed over harassment of EJK victims, families
description: . Rabid supporters and trolls defending former president Rodrigo Duterte may soon find themselves in legal trouble over their alleged harassment and trolling of extrajudicial killing victims and their families.

title: Ridon: VP Sara’s 2028 presidential bid ‘irrelevant’ to House
description: . Vice President Sara Duterte’s declaration that she intends to run for president in 2028 is “irrelevant” to the House of Representatives’ handling of the four impeachment complaints against her, Bicol Saro party-list Rep. Terry Ridon said yesterday.

title: President Marcos welcomes 3 new envoys
description: . President Marcos welcomed on Friday the new ambassadors of Slovak Republic, Papua New Guinea and Lao, stressing the strong potential for expanded cooperation with the three nations.

title: ICC judges urged: Keep Duterte in detention
description: . Almost a year since former president Rodrigo Duterte’s arrest, the prosecutor of the International Criminal Court (ICC) and the lawyers representing the victims believe there are no changes in circumstances that would warrant his release from detention.

title: Palace dismisses hospitalization rumors; President Marcos well
description: . President Marcos is “well” and working even on a Saturday, Malacañang said amid fresh rumors that the Chief Executive was brought to a hospital.

title: Recto: Philippine nears upper middle-class country status
description: . The Philippines is close to achieving its much-coveted upper middle-income country (UMIC) status this year and is now setting its sights on higher growth targets, according to Executive Secretary Ralph Recto.

title: Ombudsman skeptical on affidavit by former soldiers
description: . Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla has cast doubts on the joint affidavit executed by 18 former soldiers who claimed to have delivered millions of pesos in cash to government officials, dismissing the allegations as “canard” and politically motivated.

title: US Senate confirms new envoy to Philippines named
description: . The United States Senate has confirmed the nomination of Florida businessman Lee Lipton as the new US ambassador to Manila.

title: Trump honors Fil-Am soldier, others killed in Kuwait attack
description: . A Filipino-American was among the US soldiers killed in an Iranian drone attack in Kuwait, the Pentagon said.

title: President Marcos, VP Sara vow better protection for women
description: . President Marcos yesterday vowed to protect the rights of women and expand opportunities for them, citing their crucial role in the nation’s progress as the world marked International Women’s Day.

title: ‘Clarify role of Pinoy lawyers in Duterte defense’
description: . Saying it could have an impact on the privacy and security of victims and witnesses, the prosecutor of the International Criminal Court (ICC) has asked judges to intervene and clarify the supposed role of Filipino lawyers in the defense team of former president Rodrigo Duterte.

title: ‘DPWH delayed in bidding out infrastructure projects’
description: . The Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) has yet to bid out any infrastructure project under the 2026 national budget as of this month, Sen. Sherwin Gatchalian said yesterday as he warned that sluggish government spending combined with the ongoing oil crisis could derail the country’s economic recovery.

title: President Marcos: Don’t use aid programs for political gain
description: . The government’s aid programs should not be used to gain mileage or to engage in politicking, President Marcos said yesterday, as he pushed for simpler and more efficient means of delivering assistance and services.

title: Sandigan sets bail hearings for Revilla
description: . The Sandiganbayan has set a 10-day hearing for the bail petitions filed by former senator Ramon Revilla Jr., and former officials of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Bulacan 1st District Engineering Office (DEO), over their malversation case involving a ghost flood control project in Pandi, Bulacan.

title: President Marcos off to New York for UN assembly
description: . President Marcos left yesterday for New York City to visit the United Nations headquarters, where he is expected to call for peace in the Middle East, discuss the Philippines’ efforts to protect women’s rights and seek support for the country’s candidacy for a non-permanent seat in the UN Security Council.

title: Senators seek action vs abusive gas stations
description: . Senators yesterday called for a crackdown on gas stations prematurely raising pump prices, warning that the unabated fuel price hikes have slashed the daily take-home pay of public utility vehicle drivers to less than P300.

title: ‘Spy handlers asked for info on troops in West Philippine Sea’
description: . Espionage activities uncovered by the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) included gathering information about troops in the BRP Sierra Madre at Ayungin Shoal.

title: Iloilo program eyed as national model after raising Grade 3 reading proficiency from 28% to 90%
description: . A congressional body is pushing to replicate a literacy program in Iloilo that raised reading levels among Grade 3 students from 28% to 90% in just one year — results that come as the commission looks for scalable solutions to the nationwide reading crisis.

title: ‘Leverage ASEAN chairship to promote regional energy security’
description: . Energy Secretary Sharon Garin is urging the government to leverage the Philippines’ chairship of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations this year to promote regional energy security in light of the global oil crisis.

title: DOE: Selling fuel in drums allowed for legitimate use
description: . Gas stations can continue selling petroleum products placed in drums and containers, the Department of Energy said yesterday, as long as they are bought for “legitimate operational use.”

title: Flights to Dubai, Riyadh canceled
description: . Philippine Airlines and Cebu Pacific have continued canceling their flights to and from Dubai and Riyadh due to the ongoing conflict in the Middle East.

title: Free financial literacy education for OFWs sought
description: . Senate migrant workers committee chair Raffy Tulfo yesterday pushed for his bill giving free financial literacy education to OFWs, calling it timely amid the Middle East crisis.

title: House OKs travel tax abolition on 2nd reading
description: . The proposal to abolish the travel tax for outbound Filipino travelers was approved by the House of Representatives on second reading, paving the way for easing travel costs and a boost to tourism and economic activity.

title: Slovenia wants more Pinoy workers
description: . Slovenia wants to hire more Filipino workers, particularly caregivers, Ambassador Smiljana Knez said last week, to address demand for its aging society.

title: ACT hits DepEd’s ‘4+1’ proposal
description: . The proposed “4+1” blended learning of the Department of Education will not resolve the country’s classroom shortage and may shift the burden onto students, the Alliance of Concerned Teachers said yesterday.

title: 800 private hospitals may be barred from PhilHealth’s YAKAP
description: . Some 800 private hospitals will be barred from participating in the Philippine Health Insurance Corp.Yaman ng Kalusugan program if they fail to install an electronic medical records (EMR) system by June this year.

title: March 20 a holiday for Eid’l Fitr
description: . Malacañang has declared March 20 a regular holiday nationwide in observance of Eid’l Fitr, the end of the Muslim holy month of Ramadan.

title: 2 Pinoys nabbed in Dubai?
description: . Reports of two Filipinos arrested in Dubai for allegedly recording and posting videos of security incidents and attacks are being investigated by the Philippine diplomatic missions in the United Arab Emirates.

title: Palace: ICI closure not end of flood control inquiry
description: . The pursuit of people involved in the multibillion-peso flood control scandal continues even with the looming closure of the Independent Commission for Infrastructure, Malacañang said yesterday.

title: Over 300 Pinoys return from Bahrain, Saudi
description: . A total of 341 Filipinos from Saudi Arabia and Bahrain arrived yesterday on the second government-arranged chartered flight in the repatriation efforts for overseas Filipino workers affected by unrest in the Middle East.

title: Pinoys want continued disclosure of China’s actions
description: . Most Filipinos support the continued public disclosure of China’s actions in the West Philippine Sea even as the Philippines hosts the Association of Southeast Asian Nations this year, according to a Pulse Asia survey.

title: Guanzon, 3 others eyeing Sara’s 2028 slate
description: . Four people have expressed interest in joining her senatorial slate for the 2028 national elections, Vice President Sara Duterte revealed on Saturday.

title: Duterte lawyer hit for ‘frivolous’ appeals
description: . Lawyers representing victims in the crimes against humanity case against former president Rodrigo Duterte at the International Criminal Court have accused the defense team of filing “frivolous” appeals that they said waste the court’s time and resources.

title: LTFRB approves fare hike for provincial buses
description: . The Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board has approved the fare increases of provincial buses and other public utility vehicles amid ongoing oil price hikes.

title: Comelec decision on Marcoleta SOCE out Wednesday
description: . The Commission on Elections is expected to release on Wednesday its decision on issues surrounding the statement of contributions and expenditures filed by Sen. Rodante Marcoleta, according to Comelec Chairman George Garcia.

title: No break looms for House impeachment hearings
description: . Proceedings for the two impeachment complaints against Vice President Sara Duterte pending at the House of Representatives will most likely last beyond Congress’ March 18 recess – whether she decides to defend herself or waive her right to file a response.

title: Leviste acquires Rizal’s ‘Noli’ house in Germany
description: . On the eve of the 140th anniversary in March 2027 of its publication in the German city of Berlin, Jose Rizal’s “Noli Me Tangere” – the book that changed the course of Philippine history – is in the headlines once again.

title: Marcos, Bhutanese leader meet
description: . he diplomatic ties between the Philippines and Bhutan yesterday achieved a historic first with the meeting of President Marcos and Bhutanese Prime Minister Tshering Tobgay at Malacañang.

title: Airlines seek parking fees cut at NAIA
description: . Airline companies operating at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport appealed to the Department of Transportation (DOTr) yesterday for a cut on airport fees at NAIA, as fuel prices increase and flights to the Middle East remain suspended because of the ongoing tension in the region.

title: Marcos affirms commitment  to national defense
description: . The administration’s commitment to national security remains “firm,” President Marcos said yesterday, as he vowed to continue modernizing the military and to enhance the Philippine Army’s role in external defense.

title: DA chief files raps vs Co, Baligod
description: . Following corruption accusations, Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr. yesterday filed separate cyberlibel cases against fugitive Zaldy Co and Levito Baligod, lawyer of the 18 alleged bagmen.

title: Alcantara  to testify vs Co
description: . Henry Alcantara, a former district engineer of the Bulacan regional office of the Department of Public Works and Highways and now state witness, will testify in the trial of the malversation case against resigned lawmaker and now fugitive Zaldy Co and 15 others in connection with the alleged substandard P289.5-million flood control project in Naujan, Oriental Mindoro.

title: Hearing on VP impeach complaints may be aired live
description: . The next House hearing on the impeachment complaints against Vice President Sara Duterte may become the first full live public airing of the initial evidence behind the complaints, Manila 3rd district Rep. Joel Chua said yesterday.

title: DBM called out over delays in budget release
description: . Speaker Faustino Dy III called out on Wednesday the Department of Budget and Management (DBM) over delays in fund releases, warning that slow disbursement renders even approved budgets meaningless and delays urgently needed services for Filipinos.

title: DPWH suspends reduced prices on construction materials  materials
description: . The skyrocketing prices of oil and basic commodities caused by the escalating conflict in the Middle East is supposedly also driving up the cost of delivery of construction materials and operating equipment, causing Public Works Secretary Vince Dizon to temporarily suspend the lowered Construction Materials Price Data (CMPD) he set last November to bust the so-called built-in overprice of infrastructure projects of the Department of Public Works and Highway.

title: Marcos Jr.  inspects new classrooms in Bataan
description: . President Marcos yesterday visited Bataan to inspect newly installed prefabricated classrooms, one of the government measures aimed at addressing the country’s classroom shortage.

title: 317 more  Pinoys return to Philippines
description: . A total of 317 Filipinos from the Middle East returned to the Philippines yesterday aboard the government’s third chartered flight from the Middle East.

title: Citing fuel costs, Cebu Pacific trims routes as passengers report disruptions
description: . Cebu Pacific is reducing flights as rising fuel prices linked to the Middle East crisis hit airline operations.

title: Atong Ang asks DOJ to drop him from Manila Arena 'sabungeros' case
description: . Atong Ang moved to be excluded from missing sabungeros case.

title: 2-day transport strike set this week
description: . A fresh wave of transport strikes is set for Thursday and Friday, organized by a coalition of transportation groups, commuters and workers demanding more concrete government action on surging fuel prices.

title: Some lawmakers urge government to postpone Asean summit
description: . Some lawmakers are urging the government to seriously consider postponing the holding of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Summit in the Philippines this year to free up public funds amid soaring inflation and a crippling global oil crisis.

title: Palace defers ICI findings to ombudsman
description: . Malacañang is leaving it to the ombudsman to disclose the flood control findings of the Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI).

title: Lawyer on Comelec’s Marcoleta ruling: One for the books
description: . Election lawyer Romulo Macalintal slammed the decision of the Commission on Elections (Comelec) to clear Sen. Rodante Marcoleta of the complaints against him for not disclosing P75 million worth of donations during his Senate campaign.

title: Pag-asa Island ‘patriotic tours’ launched next month
description: . The municipal government of Kalayaan has opened 15 slots for its Balik-Kalayaan Tour, a “patriotic tour” around Pag-asa Island starting April 28.

title: No word from VP on attending impeach hearing
description: . Will Vice President Sara Duterte appear at tomorrow’s House hearing on the two impeachment complaints against her?

title: No oil crisis, but crisis committee formed
description: . President Marcos has ordered the creation of a crisis committee to address the impact of the Middle East conflict, even as Malacañang maintained there is no oil crisis yet in the country as supply remains stable.

title: Cebu Pacific suspends, cuts international flights
description: . Budget carrier Cebu Pacific is cutting its international flight volume to reduce fuel consumption, a move that would hurt travelers from provinces.

title: Senators: Hold abusive oil companies accountable
description: . The Senate’s probe into the government response to the Middle East crisis is zeroing in on oil companies, with lawmakers seeking to hold firms accountable for possible profiteering as fuel prices surge.

title: CBCP: Oil crisis may affect Visita Iglesia
description: . The Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines (CBCP) acknowledged that the oil crisis may affect the observance of the Visita Iglesia or church visits during Holy Week, in the face of the continuing surge in the prices of petroleum products.

title: Government earmarks P230 billion for Mideast crisis response
description: . The Philippine government can tap as much as P230.2 billion to fund cash subsidies, fuel procurement and programs to cushion the disruptions arising from the Middle East war, acting Budget Secretary Rolando Toledo said.

title: PNPA grads told: Zero tolerance for corruption, rights abuses
description: . President Marcos yesterday reminded this year’s graduates of the Philippine National Police Academy (PNPA) to have zero tolerance for corruption and human rights abuses, and to ensure the safety of communities and stability of the country amid ongoing international conflicts.

title: PAL suspends flights to Riyadh
description: . In the face of continued tensions in the Middle East, Philippine Airlines (PAL) has suspended flights between Manila and Riyadh until March 31.

title: Softer oil price hikes seen next week
description: . Motorists may see a modest rise in gasoline prices next week, but diesel remains on track for another double-digit spike amid the global oil crisis.

title: Lawmakers hit petition before SC on VP impeachment
description: . Lawmakers yesterday slammed the camp of Vice President Sara Duterte over the filing of a petition in the Supreme Court seeking to halt the impeachment proceedings.

title: President Marcos: ‘Very bare-bones’ Asean summit to push through
description: . The Philippines will push through with its hosting of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Summit, President Marcos said yesterday, amid calls from some quarters to postpone it to free up public funds to support vulnerable sectors heavily impacted by the skyrocketing fuel prices sparked by the Middle East conflict.

title: Transport strike ends, with excise tax removal in limbo
description: . The second week of the transport strike ended yesterday with one of their calls – to remove excise tax on petroleum products – still in limbo.

title: Philippines, France sign Status of Visiting Forces Agreement
description: . The Philippines has signed its Status of Visiting Forces Agreement (SOVFA) with France, the country’s first with a European partner, on the sidelines of the ongoing 2026 Paris Defense and Strategy Forum.

title: Philippines to rename over 100 Kalayaan Island Group features
description: . The Philippines will adopt local names for more than 100 features in the Kalayaan Island Group following an order issued by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

title: Bangsamoro religious authority rules against forced marriage for rape survivors
description: . The Bangsamoro Darul Ifta has officially declared that forcing a rape survivor to marry her perpetrator is strictly prohibited under Shari'ah law.

title: Palace: All measures being done to protect consumers
description: . As the Department of Trade and Industry expects price increases in some commodities after April 15 due to the soaring fuel costs spawned by the war in the Middle East, Malacañang yesterday assured the public that the government would implement all necessary measures to cushion the impact on consumers.

title: Marcos orders naming of 131 features in KIG
description: . President Marcos has ordered the giving of local names to 131 features of the Kalayaan Island Group (KIG) in the West Philippine Sea.

title: Teachers, groups seek stronger government support amid Middle East crisis
description: . Private school teachers and education groups yesterday pressed the government for urgent support and policy flexibility as the ongoing Middle East crisis continues to strain the education sector.

title: Herbosa sued over P1.4 billion expired meds, vaccines
description: . A group of “concerned Department of Health personnel” has filed a graft complaint before the Office of the Ombudsman against Health Secretary Teodoro Herbosa and 16 other officials over the alleged wastage of P1.4 billion worth of medicines and vaccines.

title: Over 5 million passengers per day expected during Holy Week
description: . More than five million passengers per day are expected to travel during Holy Week, Transportation Secretary Giovanni Lopez said yesterday.

title: ‘Impeachment no distraction from other concerns’
description: . The House of Representatives can address the country’s urgent concerns while still carrying out its constitutional duty to hear the impeachment complaints against Vice President Sara Duterte, House assistant majority leader and Lanao del Sur 1st district Rep. Zia Alonto Adiong said yesterday.

title: ICI shuts down; Palace says flood mess not forgotten
description: . After the Independent Commission for Infrastructure yesterday ceased operations upon submitting its confidential final report, Malacañang maintained that President Marcos has not forgotten the fight against corruption.

title: SWS: Filipinos’ personal well-being at record low
description: . Filipinos’ assessment of their personal well-being fell to a historic low in the last quarter of 2025, according to a survey by Social Weather Stations .

title: Price Tracker: Oil, fuel monitor for Apr. 5
description: . Price Tracker lists the latest Metro Manila benchmark prices compiled from available reported figures.

title: Ex-SEC officials, staff cleared of ‘unauthorized’ salary increase
description: . Former officials and employees of the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) will no longer have to return P92 million worth of funds allotted for salary increases, which the Commission on Audit (COA) previously flagged as unauthorized, the Supreme Court ruled.

title: Gatchalian vows to protect girl asking President Marcos for help
description: . The Department of Social Welfare and Development is taking legal and protective actions against a barangay official in Camarines Sur, following allegations of harassment and abuses committed by his two sons against several children, DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian said on Wednesday.

title: Servings of rice, pan de sal to get smaller – lawmaker
description: . Filipinos should brace for smaller size pan de sal and smaller servings of rice in eateries as prices of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) and kerosene continue to rise, Senior Citizens party-list Rep. Rodolfo Ordanes warned on Thursday.

title: Speaker renews push for alternative energy sources
description: . With the global oil crisis deepening and highlighting the country’s heavy dependence on imported petroleum products, Speaker Faustino Dy III is renewing his push for alternative and indigenous sources of energy that are readily available in the country.

title: Chinese research vessel spotted in Philippine Rise
description: . A Chinese research boat was spotted operating illegally in the Philippines’ eastern waters, particularly in the potentially oil- and gas-rich Philippine (Benham) Rise.

title: 200,000 jobs ready for OFWs displaced by Mideast crisis
description: . Around 200,000 job opportunities abroad for returning overseas Filipino workers are being prepared by the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW), as the total number of repatriated OFWs from the Middle East exceeded 4,000.

title: Holy Week generally peaceful – PNP
description: . Despite at least seven drowning incidents documented in the country, the Philippine National Police described the observance of Holy Week as generally peaceful.

title: BOC takes custody of P143 million vehicles
description: . The Bureau of Customs (BOC) has taken full custody of eight high-value vehicles worth approximately P143 million after the Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) ceased operations.

title: Lacson lauds DFA chief over Iran oil deal
description: . Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo Lacson has commended Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) Secretary Ma. Theresa Lazaro for her “quiet diplomacy” in securing the safe passage of Philippine-flagged vessels, energy shipments and Filipino seafarers through the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Immigration: Rule-breaking foreigners in Siargao to face penalties
description: . The Bureau of Immigration said that foreign nationals in Siargao who violate immigration laws will face sanctions.

title: Price Tracker: Oil, fuel monitor for Apr. 8
description: . Oil firms implemented major increases this week, pushing diesel prices above P140 to P150 per liter in several areas.

title: Lawmaker to ERC: Fast-track refunds
description: . Ako Bicol party-list Rep. Alfredo Garbin Jr. urged yesterday the Energy Regulatory Commission to fast-track refunds and consider the suspension of value added tax amid summer power demand.

title: Over 11,000 OFW teachers return to Philippines classrooms
description: . At least 11,056 licensed teachers have transitioned from overseas employment back into Philippine public school classrooms, the Department of Education said.

title: House tackles Middle East crisis solutions today
description: . Solutions to lessen the impact of the Middle East war will be discussed today at a “high-level joint hearing” spearheaded by the House ways and means panel.

title: Experts divided on legality of unprogrammed funds
description: . Amid challenges raised over alleged insertions in the national budgets for 2024, 2025 and 2026, experts were divided on whether these additions go beyond what the Constitution prescribes.

title: PUV drivers reduce trips amid price hikes
description: . Around 20 percent of public utility vehicle drivers and operators have reduced their trips as fuel prices continue to rise, according to Pagkakaisa ng mga Samahan ng Tsuper at Operator Nationwide.

title: ‘No evidence vs Romualdez in flood control mess’
description: . There is no evidence linking Rep. Martin Romualdez to any ghost or substandard projects that the Office of the Ombudsman said could be basis for the filing of plunder charges against him, his lawyer said yesterday.

title: Free rides in Metro Manila begin April 15
description: . Commuters in Metro Manila can expect free rides as the service contracting program for public utility vehicles will begin on April 15.
